# Code

## Showing code

Code is not echoed by default.

```{r}
#| echo: true
ggplot2::qplot(x = Sepal.Length, data = iris)
```

## Highlighting lines

Line numbers need to be set manually

```{css, echo=FALSE}
.reveal pre code {
  overflow: visible;
}
```

```{r, attr.source = ".numberLines"}
iris |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    mapping = aes(
      x = Sepal.Length,
      y = Sepal.Width
    )
  )
```
